description: Creates a signature request, adds its documents (uploading the bytes), adds the signatories one by one and any observers, places each signature, waits for the documents to be processed and SENDS it to the signers — in ONE call, instead of chaining signature_request_create, signature_request_add_document, signature_participant_create, signature_coordinate_set and activate_signature_request. Sending is irreversible: confirm with your user first, or pass activate: false for a draft. Requires case_file_create → caseFileId and a NEW requestId (UUID v4); reuse it with the same caseFileId to retry — an existing request is reported, never created twice. Every signatory signs every document. Plan limits on documents and participants per request apply. A PDF (or a .docx with convertToPdf) needs a position for every signatory: if one is missing the call is refused BEFORE anything is created — read the PDF to find the signature page and send coordinates, or pass activate: false. Returns requestId, document/signatory/observer ids and the status: ACTIVE once sent; DRAFT with activate: false or if the documents were still processing (then use activate_signature_request). If a later step fails, the error lists the ids created, the request's state and what to do.

activate.description: true (default): send it once the documents are ready — irreversible, confirm with your user. false: leave a DRAFT.

caseFileId.description: UUID of the case file (case_file_create → caseFileId).

closeCondition.description: ALL_REQUIRED (default): it completes when everyone has signed. PARTIAL_ALLOWED: it completes once no signature is pending — a signatory who rejects does not block the others.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date-time, in the future, at most 31 days ahead.

documents.description: Documents to sign (the plan may allow fewer per request). Every signatory signs every document.

convertToPdf.description: Only for .docx: convert to PDF first.

file.description: Local path (stdio mode), base64 content or an HTTPS URL.

path.description: Absolute local path to the file (stdio/local mode only).

url.description: HTTPS URL to fetch the file from (SSRF-guarded).

binaryRef.description: Reference to an n8n binary item from a prior node.

fileName.description: With extension; default: the file's own name. Unique per request.

observers.description: Receive a read-only copy; never sign.

requestId.description: A NEW UUID v4 you generate, never used before in any case file. Reuse it (same caseFileId) to retry: an existing request is reported, never re-created.

signatories.description: People who must sign; a phone is required for ADVANCED.

coordinates.description: Where this person signs: {document (index in documents, from 0), page (from 1), x, y} — PDF points from the page's bottom-left corner; (x, y) is the bottom-left corner of the signature stamp (it spans x+15..x+104, y..y+66.5). Required on every PDF.

sendSmsUrl.description: INTERPOSITION: also send the link by RCS/SMS, if the platform has it enabled.

sendWaUrl.description: INTERPOSITION: also send the link by WhatsApp. With a phone the platform does it unless you pass false.

signatureType.description: INTERPOSITION (default): simple signature, link by email (and WhatsApp/SMS on request). ADVANCED: one-time code to the signer's mobile, so every signatory needs a phone; no WhatsApp/SMS.

waitSeconds.description: Wait for READY_TO_SIGN before sending (default 25; keep the call under your client's timeout); if not ready, it stays a DRAFT.

name: signature_request_full
